## What it checks (sampled describe/it titles)

- StabilityRPM — Basic Rewrite
- rewrites unstable RPM to nearest stable pocket
- preserves already-stable RPM values
- preserves lines without S commands
- handles multiple S commands in one program
- reports WARNING when no stable RPM exists in search range
